title.ja: 可変エディントン因子：周期1D散乱源の固定検証
title.en: Variable Eddington factor: a periodic 1D scattering-source control

summary.ja: 形式的な角度輸送と独立なモーメント方程式を反復結合し、位置で変わる因子fを閉形式参照と比較します。
summary.en: Iteratively couple formal angular transport to independent moment equations and compare the spatially varying factor f with a closed-form reference.

assumptions.ja: 静止・定常・灰色の単位周期区間。無次元でσt=4、σs=3、σa=1、c=1。q=1+0.3 cos(2πx)、x_i=i/Nの点値です。角度平均は(1/2)∫I dμで規格化します。
assumptions.en: Static steady grey unit-periodic interval; dimensionless st=4, ss=3, sa=1 and c=1. q=1+0.3 cos(2pi x), sampled as point values at x_i=i/N. Angular averages use (1/2) integral I dmu.

algorithm.ja: 各反復でq+σs E_LOをFourier形式解へ入れ、f=Kxx/E_HOを抽出し、保存的な面流束を使う有限差分モーメント式を解きます。参照解は主計算の閉包へ渡しません。
algorithm.en: At each iteration solve formal Fourier transport with q+ss E_LO, extract f=Kxx/E_HO, and solve finite-difference moment equations using shared conservative faces. The primary closure never receives the analytic reference.

validation.ja: N=33/65と固定32点角度則、N=65の64点角度プローブを分けます。解析場・複素モード・保存・実現可能性・反復残差・誤符号等の負制御、別のN=9一定源行を照合します。
validation.en: Separate N=33/65 refinement at32 angular points from a64-point probe at N=65. Check analytic fields and complex modes, conservation, realizability, iteration residuals, negative controls and a separate N=9 constant-source row.

limits.ja: 図の横軸xと角度余弦μは2つの空間次元ではありません。周期・一様係数の教育例で、流入境界、時間発展、物質・流体結合、非線形FLD、一般AP性や速度向上は検証しません。
limits.en: Position x and angular cosine mu are not two spatial dimensions. This periodic homogeneous educational control does not validate inflow boundaries, time evolution, material/fluid coupling, nonlinear FLD, general AP properties or speedup.

title.ja: 可変エディントンテンソル：周期2D非平行源の固定検証
title.en: Variable Eddington tensor: a periodic 2D nonparallel-source control

summary.ja: 非平行な2つの源モードから全S²角度分布と3×3テンソルを求め、Dxyを含む保存的モーメント式と閉形式参照を比較します。
summary.en: Use two nonparallel source modes to compute full-S2 angular moments and a3x3 tensor, then compare conservative moment equations including Dxy with a closed-form reference.

assumptions.ja: 静止・定常・灰色の単位周期正方形。σt=4、σs=3、σa=1、c=1の無次元点値。q=1+0.3 cos(2πx)+0.2 sin(2π(x+y))。空間は2Dでも角度は全S²でDzzも保持します。
assumptions.en: Static steady grey unit-periodic square; dimensionless st=4, ss=3, sa=1 and c=1, using point samples. q=1+0.3 cos(2pi x)+0.2 sin(2pi(x+y)). Space is2D, but directions cover full S2 and Dzz is retained.

algorithm.ja: 形式的なFourier角度輸送→D=K_HO/E_HO→独立な有限差分モーメント式を反復します。Dxyの両交差微分を共有面流束へ含め、局所・大域の離散収支を確認します。
algorithm.en: Iterate formal Fourier angular transport, D=K_HO/E_HO, and an independent finite-difference moment solve. Include both Dxy cross derivatives in shared face fluxes and check local/global discrete budgets.

validation.ja: 17²/33²と12×48角度則、33²の16×64角度プローブを区別します。解析E/H/K/D、位相を含む複素モード、独立角度積分、テンソル制約、混合項の負制御、N=9²一定源を照合します。
validation.en: Separate17x17/33x33 refinement at12x48 angles from the16x64 angular probe on33x33. Check analytic E/H/K/D, complex modes including phase, independent angular integration, tensor constraints, cross-term negative controls and a9x9 constant source.

limits.ja: 局所M1との比較は閉包の点ごとの診断だけで、M1方程式は解きません。Athena・短い特性線法・影・交差ビーム・RHD・境界閉包の再現でもなく、固定格子でHO/LOの厳密一致や普遍的な収束率を主張しません。
limits.en: Pointwise M1 comparison is a closure diagnostic; no M1 PDE is solved. This is not a reproduction of Athena, short characteristics, shadows, crossing beams, RHD or boundary closures, and does not claim exact fixed-grid HO/LO agreement or universal convergence rates.
